subject: Michael Owen
title: Owen's pundit tips, horses and a yard off

lines.vo: Michael Owen beat Raul to the Ballon d'Or, 176 votes to 140.
That was 2001, at twenty-two. Now he tells everyone else what they are doing wrong.
Owen says Isak is running out of excuses, a yard off the pace. Liverpool need a return on about 125 million pounds. Expensive yard.
Owen runs Manor House Stables, with about 140 horses in training. Finally, a team that cannot answer back.
lines.footage: Racing yard, horses in training, neutral shot

lines.vo: Two of his Bahrain runners finished eighth and tenth of thirteen. Trainer Hugo Palmer says they will go again. A yard off, perhaps.
Owen says he will never play football again. Now he sells the dream of racing, one horse at a time.
Yet he says his Ballon d'Or means more now. The stable has no golden ball yet.
Think you can call the next one? Free tips, results and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.
